summary: Implemented the reports browser and static knowledge report: the console now discovers .boreal/results artifacts, marks stale exports, exposes reproducible static export commands, renders a generated knowledge report snapshot, and documents the Reports route. Generated live project, knowledge, and reports HTML exports plus a Markdown export under .boreal/results.
command: pnpm check; pnpm test; pnpm console:build; git diff --check; pnpm bwrk export markdown --out .boreal/results/markdown-export --json; node apps/console/dist/render-file.js --workspace . --mode live --route / --out .boreal/results/console-project.html; node apps/console/dist/render-file.js --workspace . --mode live --route /knowledge --out .boreal/results/console-knowledge.html; node apps/console/dist/render-file.js --workspace . --mode live --route /reports --out .boreal/results/console-reports.html
